name: portalfoursys
description: Portal Institucional Foursys + Jarvis (voz) — monorepo (branch feature/portal-jarvis)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n jarvis,portal -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:jarvis" "npm run dev:portal"
scripts.build: npm --prefix ./jarvis run build && npm --prefix ./portal run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix ./jarvis run lint && npm --prefix ./portal run lint
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix ./jarvis install && npm --prefix ./portal install
scripts.docker:deploy: docker compose build && docker compose up -d
